name: Firecrawl
short: Web scraping, crawling, and clean markdown extraction API built specifically for LLM context windows and autonomous agent pipelines.

plans.name: Free Plan
plans.notes: Instant API key upon signup (no credit card required) with 1,000 free credits refreshed every month (1 page = 1 credit) and up to 2 concurrent browser sessions for local development.

plans.name: Hobby Plan
plans.notes: 5,000 monthly credits with higher concurrency, priority queueing, and structured JSON extraction modifiers.
